newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT-Fil-Estate-Filinvest said good buys.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Fil-Estate-Filinvest said good buys.

text.p: Philippine Asia Equity said on Tuesday that Fil-Estate Land Inc and Filinvest Land Inc were "ripe for picking."

Analyst Ivy Cayayan said in her report that both property issues have underperformed the market after investors lightened their portfolio on fears of a possible bursting of the bubble in the high-end property market.
Cayayan projected a 20 percent increase in Fil-Estate's net income this year from new projects, interest income and recognition of deferred profits.

"Fil-Estate is already trading at a PE ratio of 9.0 times this year, a 43 percent discount to the market and growing its net income by at least 20 percent per annum. It is also at a 47 percent discount to its net asset value of 43 pesos," she said.
She said Filinvest Land had the potential to grow by at least 35 pecent this year.
"We recommend a trading buy on this stock ... there is a 12 percent upside," she added.
